item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In May 2023, residents in Nagu, Yunnan, clashed with large numbers of police over planned demolition of the Najiaying Mosque's dome; police issued a surrender and reporting notice, and dozens were arrested.","notes":["The excerpt supports planned demolition, but not the broader wording “demolition or alteration” for this incident."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Najiaying Mosque dispute followed a 2020 court judgment that ruled architectural additions illegal and ordered their removal; authorities' later attempt to enforce that order appears to have sparked the 2023 demonstrations.","notes":["The excerpt says the enforcement actions “appear to have sparked” the demonstrations, so the causal wording must remain qualified."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A 2023 Chinese economics study using 2010–2020 listed-firm data and the 2015 Budget Law as a quasi-natural experiment found that local-government debt governance reduced firms' credit mismatch, excessive indebtedness, leverage manipulation, shadow-banking and financialization-related risk correlations, and was ultimately conducive to more stable operating performance.","notes":["The excerpt identifies the article and empirical design but does not establish peer-review status. The final relationship is described as conducive to stable performance, not as an unconditional causal finding."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On March 10, 2023, Xi was unanimously re-elected by the National People's Congress to a third term as state president and also unanimously re-elected as chairman of the state Central Military Commission; NPR reported that he had orchestrated the abolition of presidential term limits and had surrounded himself with loyalists and allies, with further loyalist appointments expected.","notes":["The excerpt supports loyalists and allies surrounding Xi and expected further appointments, but not that loyalists already dominated key appointments."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
